name: @workwell/measure-engine
description: Headless eCQM evaluation: executes pre-compiled ELM against a FHIR R4 patient bundle and returns per-define evidence. JVM-free, node:fs-free, and content-free — the measure catalog, ELM and value-set expansions are injected by the consumer (ADR-059).
//publishConfig: The workspace resolves this package from `src/*.ts` — that is what keeps `pnpm typecheck` checking real sources rather than stale build output, and what lets a change here be seen by the app without a build step. A registry consumer has no such resolution, so pnpm rewrites these fields into the packed manifest and the tarball points at `dist/` instead. `provenance` asks npm to attest, from CI, which commit and workflow produced the tarball.
